source_text: Sancti estote quia ego sanctus. Nomen sancti in scripturis non solum homines sed loca et vasa. Disce vim nominis ut opus impleas.
pass_a_gloss: Holy be-you because I holy. Name of-holy in scriptures not only humans but places and vessels. Learn force of-name that work you-may-fulfill.
pass_b_english: [[Be holy, for I am holy >> Bible:Leviticus 19:2]]. In Scripture “holy” names not only persons but places and vessels. Learn the name’s force to do its work.
